args.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW risk_summary AS
WITH tei_calc AS (
    SELECT
        a.accindex,
        a.acctident AS account_identifier,
        0.4 * ti.vpnratio + 0.3 * ti.proxycount/10 + 0.3 * ti.ipcountrynum/20 AS tei,
        ds.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'riskval'::FLOAT AS risk_value,
        ds.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'threatlvl' AS threat_level
    FROM
        account a
    JOIN
        technicalinfo ti ON a.accindex = ti.technetref
    JOIN
        securitydetection ds ON ti.techkey = ds.sectechref
)
SELECT
    account_identifier,
    AVG(tei) AS avg_tei,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(tei) < 0.2 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN AVG(tei) < 0.5 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_level,
    AVG(risk_value) AS avg_risk_value,
    MAX(threat_level) AS max_threat_level
FROM
    tei_calc
GROUP BY
    account_identifier;
